dos.text: Give it a data-l10n-id or a real element child when you want your own link text, connectedCallback substitutes the default "moz-support-link-text" string whenever there is no l10n id and childElementCount is 0, so a plain text node gets replaced.
Reserve it for SUMO pages, its own JSDoc says other "Learn more" links should use a plain anchor element.

donts.text: Don't set href yourself, #setHref rebuilds it from the app's support base URL on connect and again on every support-page or utm-content change, overwriting whatever you assigned.
Don't assume a click follows the href normally in chrome, handleEvent calls preventDefault and routes through openTrustedLinkIn, rewriting a "current" destination to "tab".
